entries.text: Greetings. I am Hassel, the art teacher at Naranja\nAcademy—as well as a member of the Elite Four.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_first_00

entries.text: Greetings. I am Hassel, the art teacher at Uva\nAcademy—as well as a member of the Elite Four.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_first_00b

entries.text: It is such a pleasure to be able to meet all the\nfine students at Blueberry Academy.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_first_01

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Ah, young [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. So you are
the
one
who
invited
me here.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp01_00

entries.text: To think that in the brief time since I last saw you,\nyou’d gain such an important role at this school...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp01_01

entries.text: It-it’s so surprising! And I’m so habby for you...\nI...I just...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp01_02

entries.text: Please don’t cry
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp01_select_01

entries.text: Uh, Mr. Hassel?
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp01_select_02

entries.text: ...I’m very close to tears, but I’ll do my best to\nhold it in for now.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp01_03

entries.text: I don’t want to scare the other students here,\nafter all![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp01_04

entries.text: I can’t express how pleased I am to have this\nopportunity to teach at another school.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp02_00

entries.text: Although I wonder... What does this academy\nneed of me? Am I here in my capacity as an art\r\ninstructor or as a member of the Elite Four?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp02_01

entries.text: An art instructor!
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp02_select_01

entries.text: An Elite Four member!
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp02_select_02

entries.text: I would hope so, but the students’ reaction to\nmy last art lecture seemed...lukewarm.\r\nPerhaps it was my imagination, though.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp02_02

entries.text: Ah, I should have known!\c\nThat would explain the lukewarm reaction I got\nwhen I held an art lecture...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp02_02b

entries.text: You know, I have heard that Blueberry Academy\nplaces a strong emphasis on the study and\r\npractice of Pokémon battles.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp02_03

entries.text: I think that for my next lecture, I will invite\nProfessor Gible and do something a little bit\r\nmore hands-on. Thank you for your input![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp02_04

entries.text: I’ve been told that the students here at Blueberry\nAcademy voluntarily take active roles in various\r\ncommittees—and even help run the school![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp03_00

entries.text: I suppose it’s fitting that a new school like this\none would also be so boldly experimental.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp03_01

entries.text:
I admit, though, that I personally have my doubts
about saddling students with such responsibility.\c
It seems a rather great burden to place on them
when they are still so young...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp03_02

entries.text: How’s that?
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp03_select_01

entries.text: Go on...?
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp03_select_02

entries.text: Well, youth is the only period of life in which one\nmay indulge in play without a care in the world.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp03_03

entries.text: In that sense, I worry about you too, you know.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_sp03_04

entries.text: Please do take care not to overburden yourself\nwith the expectations of others.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_01_00

entries.text: Ah, but I do apologize... As I get older, I seem\nmore prone to offering unsolicited advice.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_01_01

entries.text: Now, how about we make things more cheerful—\nwith a Pokémon trade, perhaps?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_01_02

entries.text: Thank you kindly for humoring me. Now, I would\nlike to offer up a fine specimen of an Arctibax.\r\nHow about you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_01_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)] is a fitting Pokémon indeed.
I
would
expect
no less from you.\c
I will be sure to take very good care of it.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_01_04

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You’re willing to trade your [VAR 0x0101(0001)] for
my
Arctibax,
then?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_02_00

entries.text: You can’t trade Mr. Hassel a Pokémon if you\naren’t its original Trainer!
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_02_01

entries.text: You can’t trade Mr. Hassel such a rare Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_02_02

entries.text: You can’t trade Mr. Hassel a Shiny Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_02_03

entries.text:
Hmm... It’s not wise to trade when you only have
one Pokémon with you.\c
See to it that you have at least two Pokémon in
your party, and then we can trade![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_03_00

entries.text: Please don’t hesitate to come speak to me again\nshould you be in the mood for a trade.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_03_01

entries.text: Would you like to trade Pokémon with me?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_trade_04_00

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Say, young [VAR 0x0100(0000)], would you
be
willing
to
have
a
battle
with
me?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_talkto_00

entries.text: Ah, perhaps another time, then.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_cancel_00

entries.text: I’m excited to learn just how strong you’ve\nbecome.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 54]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battlestart_01

entries.text: When I faced you at the Pokémon League, your\nstrength was a work in progress—you still held\r\npotential that had yet to be fully realized.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: But now...it has become so...so unshakable...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: You’b...you’b come so far...I—I just can’t...\nBWUUUH huh huh hoi hoi![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: I hope you continue on your path with a sense of\nfreedom—and of humility.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: You came up with the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Moved to Tears emote [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]by\nwatching Hassel!
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_reward_00

entries.text: Thank you for the battle!\c\nI think someone with such skill deserves a little\ntreasure from the dragon’s hoard.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: I’m happy to battle you anytime, as long as you\nfeel you have something to learn from me.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text: Fortune smiled on me this time, but...\c\nJudging from how the match went, who knows if\nI will be so lucky next time.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text: It feels like you’ve grown more and more each\ntime I see you. It’s enough to bring a tear to this\r\nold man’s eye...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_randomtalk_00

entries.text: All the students here at Blueberry Academy are\nso nice. It truly is a pleasure to teach them.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_randomtalk_01

entries.text: You know, I saw Brassie on one of those big TV\nscreens in Levincia. Doesn’t it make you happy\r\nto see a friend giving it their all?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_randomtalk_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]The [VAR 0x0101(0001)] you traded me is just the
sweetest
thing,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].\c
It always seems happy to serve as a model for my
paintings![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_randomtalk_03

entries.text: How is Arctibax doing, by the way? He loves\nbelly rubs, so don’t be afraid to give him a good\r\nscratching from time to time![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_dragon_randomtalk_04
